-- Softmax-weighted average per category. The per-category max logit is
-- subtracted before exp() (log-sum-exp trick): it cancels in the ratio but
-- prevents overflow, since cos/0.001 can reach 1000.
WITH scored AS (
    SELECT category,
           rating,
           (1 - (emb <=> $1::vector(384))) / 0.001::float8 AS logit
    FROM reviews
    WHERE emb IS NOT NULL
      AND rating IS NOT NULL
),
shifted AS (
    SELECT category,
           rating,
           logit - max(logit) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS z
    FROM scored
),
weighted AS (
    SELECT category,
           rating,
           -- exp() of very negative values is ~0; clamp to avoid underflow errors
           CASE WHEN z < -700 THEN 0::float8 ELSE exp(z) END AS w
    FROM shifted
)
SELECT category,
       sum(w * rating) / sum(w) AS weighted_avg_rating
FROM weighted
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

-- Rolling softmax-weighted average over the current review and the 49
-- previous ones in the same category. Logits are shifted by the constant 1/T
-- (cos <= 1), i.e. w = exp((cos - 1) / T) = exp(-cosine_distance / T); the
-- shift cancels in the ratio and keeps every exponent in [-100, 0].
SELECT id,
       category,
       ts,
       rating,
       sum(w * rating) OVER win / sum(w) OVER win AS rolling_weighted_avg_rating
FROM (
    SELECT id,
           category,
           ts,
           rating,
           exp(-(emb <=> $1::vector(384)) / 0.02::float8) AS w
    FROM reviews
) s
WINDOW win AS (
    PARTITION BY category
    ORDER BY ts, id
    ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)
ORDER BY category, ts, id;
```
